{{Top|leg}}
Deflectors provided limited protection against all types of energy. The '''deflector Mark II''' [[droid shield]]s were much hardier than the [[Droid deflector Mark I|Mark I]] and allowed a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] to stay exposed to [[Realspace/Legends|space]], even when passing close to [[Star/Legends|stars]].

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 2 to be able to equip this item.
